name: Esther
summary: Esther was a Jewish orphan raised by her cousin Mordecai who became queen to King Ahasuerus. She risked her life to go before the king and saved her people from Haman's plot to destroy them.

key_moments.title: Made Queen
key_moments.description: When Esther's turn came to go to the king, she won the favor of all who saw her. The king loved her more than all the other women and put the royal crown on her head in place of Vashti.

key_moments.title: Three Days of Fasting
key_moments.description: Esther asked all the Jews in Shushan to fast for her three days and nights, and said she and her maidens would fast too. Then she would go in to the king, against the law, even if it cost her life.

key_moments.title: Before the King
key_moments.description: Three days later Esther stood in the king's inner court, and he held out his golden sceptre to her. She invited the king and Haman to a banquet she had prepared.

key_moments.title: Esther Names the Enemy
key_moments.description: At her next banquet Esther asked the king for her life and the lives of her people, who had been sold to be destroyed. When the king asked who had done this, she said it was this wicked Haman.

key_moments.title: The Days of Purim
key_moments.description: Queen Esther and Mordecai wrote with full authority to confirm the days of Purim. Esther's decree settled these matters, and it was recorded.
